nodes.label: cargo-r2 refuses to run unless the five R2 sccache variables match exactly, turning a silent local-cache fallback into an explicit error

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - lokasi-demo-live-waiting-room [ses_f225c059cffexMb9kvXx8YjxOp].md:L6722] it is mandatory by config rather than by Cargo: .cargo/config.toml sets rustc-wrapper = "sccache-cargo" globally, so the launcher's job is to convert "the cache silently falls back to local disk and is not shared with the VPS" into a clear error
